title: 名誉毀損国賠第２回口頭弁論
title_en: Second oral argument in defamation compensation case.
contents: ・原告準備書面(２)、同(３)陳述、書証提出・原告は書証のうち、ＳＮＳのコメントの前提となっている報道の内容を６月中に追加して立証する・被告は準備書面(２)に対する反論を７月３１日を期限に提出する・原告は準備書面(３)に関連して、法学者の意見書を７月３１日までに提出予定
contents_en: ・Submission of plaintiff's preliminary documents (2), (3) statements, and documentary evidence The plaintiff will add to the documentary evidence by June the content of the news reports that form the basis of the SNS comments. The defendant will submit a response to preparatory brief (2) by July 31. The plaintiff plans to submit a legal scholar's opinion in connection with preparatory document (3) by July 31.

title: 名誉毀損国賠第1回口頭弁論
title_en: First oral argument in defamation compensation case
contents: ・原告訴状等陳述、書証提出・被告答弁書陳述、書証提出・原告求釈明の処理、主張整理　被告は、最高裁平成9年9月9日判決の枠組みは前提としつつも、談話の内容は事実の摘示といえないという主張であることを確認した。　　原告は、上記判決の枠組みをふまえ、次回までに、一般の読者の普通の注意と読み方を基準に、黙示の事実の摘示があったといえる判断過程を明らかにする主張を補充する。　裁判所は、被告答弁書のうち、審理、立証の過程をくだくだと論じている部分については、一般の読者の普通の注意と読み方という前提からは、重要性が高いと考えてないという認識を示した。
contents_en: ・Statement of plaintiff's complaint, etc., submission of documentary evidence- Defendant's statement of defense, submission of documentary evidence- Processing of the plaintiff's request for clarification and organization of argumentsThe defendant acknowledged that, while acknowledging the framework of the Supreme Court judgment of September 9, 1997, their argument was that the content of the statements could not be considered a statement of fact.Based on the framework of the above judgment, the plaintiff will supplement their arguments by the next hearing by clarifying the process by which they determined that there was an implied factual disclosure, based on the ordinary attention and reading of an average reader.The court indicated that, regarding the parts of the defendant's answer that elaborate on the trial and evidence-gathering process, it did not consider them to be of high importance from the perspective of "the ordinary attention and reading of the average reader."
